patch_resolves_note: The staged patch.diff only changes documentation in lib/includes/gnutls/gnutls.h.in and does not touch lib/x509/mpi.c or the OCSP certificate-print path. The fixed image therefore cannot serve as repair evidence for this witnessed MSAN bug.

nodes.description: The strcmp site compares the 22-byte RSA-PSS OID string literal, including its terminator, against oid even though only 21 bytes were initialized from asn1_read_value.

edges.description: The stack buffer oid is 128 bytes wide, but by the time strcmp executes only the 21-byte RSA-PSS OID text has been materialized, leaving the tail undefined for the sink-side C-string read.

root_cause_criterion.description: The vulnerable code declares `char oid[MAX_OID_SIZE];` without initialization before later using oid as a NUL-terminated C string at strcmp.
root_cause_criterion.verification_note: The required assertion is violated in the vulnerable trace (zero_init=0). The staged patch.diff and provided fixed image are unrelated to this code path, so the fixed-side differential cannot confirm that the missing initialization is repaired.
